source.title: The New Contenders
source.summary: De-dollarization, BRICS, CBDCs, crypto. Rhetoric vs reality in the challenge to dollar dominance.
source.author: Islamic Economics
source.body_text: Everyone talks about de-dollarization, but the dollar's structural advantages are enormous and no alternative comes close. BRICS ambitions face coordination problems. China's yuan internationalization requires capital account openness that Beijing resists. Central Bank Digital Currencies offer financial inclusion but raise surveillance concerns. The Bitcoin and crypto Islamic debate continues. This episode separates signal from noise: the trend at the margins is real, but the dollar system isn't going anywhere soon. Muslim-majority economies remain largely passive observers rather than shapers of whatever comes next.
